available.quote: An individual holding a license to practice engineering issued by a proper authority of any jurisdiction, based on credentials that do not conflict with subsections (2) and (3) of this section and other provisions of the Engineers and Architects Regulation Act, may, upon application, be licensed as a professional engineer

requirements.value: Applicant from another jurisdiction must demonstrate good reputation and good ethical character, and pass an examination on Nebraska statutes, rules, and requirements. A 15-year licensure pathway is also available for those licensed 15+ years in one or more jurisdictions. Temporary permits may be issued for specific projects.
requirements.quote: An individual holding a license to practice engineering issued by a proper authority of any jurisdiction, based on credentials that do not conflict with subsections (2) and (3) of this section and other provisions of the Engineers and Architects Regulation Act, may, upon application, be licensed as a professional engineer after: (a) Demonstration of good reputation and good ethical character by attestation of references ... and (b) Successful passage of an examination on the statutes, rules, and other requirements unique to this state.

exists.quote: The Board of Engineers and Architects is created to administer the Engineers and Architects Regulation Act. The board shall consist of eight members appointed by the Governor for terms of five years

national_certification.value: National Council of Examiners for Engineering and Surveying (NCEES)
national_certification.quote: The board may adopt the examinations and grading procedures of the National Council of Examiners for Engineering and Surveying. The board may also adopt guidelines published by the council.

definition_quote.value: Practice of engineering means any service or creative work that requires engineering education, training, and experience in the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences. The services may include, but not be limited to, planning, providing studies, designs, drawings, specifications, and other technical submissions, and administering construction contracts.

responsible_charge_defined.quote: Responsible charge means the management of the technical and financial aspects of engineering or architectural work through an organization.

firm_practice_allowed.quote: An individual licensed under the Engineers and Architects Regulation Act may practice or offer to practice the profession of architecture or engineering through an organization if the criteria for organizational practice established by the board are met and the organization has been issued a certificate of authorization by the board.

value: Detached single-family through four-family dwelling of less than five thousand square feet

board_engineering_disciplines_represente.quote: Four professional engineer members, three of whom shall be appointed after consulting with the appropriate engineering professional organizations, and one education member who is a faculty member of the University of Nebraska appointed upon the recommendation of the Dean of Engineering of the University of Nebraska

board_member_responsible_charge_years_re.quote: Each architect or professional engineer member shall have been engaged in the active practice of the design profession for at least ten years and shall have been licensed in the relevant profession for at least five years at the time of his or her appointment.
